before.value: The MKP salt preparation is traced to the complete JCM source and its exact batch inputs. Preserve the named preparation and its component stages; no name-only generic salt mixture or final-medium concentration is substituted.

after: MediaDive medium1895 explicitly identifies DSMZ as its source. Solution6635 is the MKP multicomponent medium base containing CMRL1066, Neopeptone, HEPES, sodium citrate, glucose, sodium pyruvate, N-acetylglucosamine and sodium bicarbonate, followed by pH7.6 adjustment with 5 M NaOH, 0.45 micrometre filtration and making up to1000 ml with distilled water. Solution6636 separately combines this MKP base with heat-inactivated human serum and bovine serum albumin. Preserve these preparation stages and exact input quantities; do not infer CMRL1066 stock strength from an unrelated product.
